name: handoff
description: Keeps the prompt cache warm while you are away, writes a handoff note, and restarts in a fresh conversation

keepAlive.title: Cache keep-alive
keepAlive.description: Keep the main conversation's prompt cache warm while you are away

keepAliveCount.title: Keep-alive count
keepAliveCount.description: How many times to refresh the cache after a reply ends

keepAliveIntervalMin.title: Keep-alive interval (min)
keepAliveIntervalMin.description: Minutes between cache refreshes; mainly for testing

usageStopPercent.title: Stop at plan usage (%)
usageStopPercent.description: Skip keep-alive when any plan usage window is at or above this

warnPercent.title: Context warning (%)
warnPercent.description: Warn when context usage goes above this

autoGenPercent.title: Auto-handoff at (%)
autoGenPercent.description: Prepare a handoff when context usage goes above this
